body: Implemented Settings and CLI profile creation/selection in one daemon. Each profile has separate project folders and workspace state; existing data remains in Owner, and every paired device can select every profile. The 494-test local gate, affected Chromium/WebKit suites and navigation-adapted broad HTTPS smoke pass. Rebuilt and restarted the existing HTTPS application with 25 prior resource versions, one Focus pin, settings, instance/epoch and certificate preserved; all 32 frontend assets match. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-trusted-user-profiles.md. This implements the owner's trusted-user direction following the earlier folder review; private access control, shared projects and physical-device/release acceptance remain outside this result.

metadata.summary: Implemented trusted user profiles with separate project folders
